foundation: ServerEvent model and server-scoped repository contract; SQLite migration 123 and PostgreSQL migration 025. Agent reports three SQLite repository tests passed; PostgreSQL runtime verification remains open.

review: Variable-fraction timestamp ordering corrected with fixed-width UTC storage; regression covers fractional end/order and concurrent CAS winner. Positive RSVP uses atomic conditional INSERT for scheduled future events, conflicts otherwise; withdrawal remains allowed.
databaseVerification: Main actual PostgreSQL 18 event repository tests passed count=3 after final RSVP changes (22.342s), including migrations/time normalization/CAS/RSVP. Temporary no-host-port auto-removing PostgreSQL container stopped; no production or user database touched.
serviceVerification: Main Docker services -run ^TestServerEvent passed. Service enforces membership, ManageEvents, input bounds, server-scoped IDs, linked-channel actor access and viewer redaction, version conflicts and RSVP eligibility. HTTP wiring still in progress.
httpProgress: Six event routes and repo/service/handler construction wired. Bounded strict JSON, limit validation and expected account guard; manager writes require ManageEvents and service rechecks membership/roles. Main added typed-nil/empty-ID authentication regressions. Main event-focused handlers/services/repository tests passed.
viewerRSVP: Event responses now include caller-specific interested boolean via IsInterested repository lookup; errors propagate rather than returning a false value. No attendee identity list is exposed. Agent and main event-focused service/repository tests passed.
clientAPI: Typed six-endpoint event API with account/generation guard, 15-second deadline, encoded IDs and pagination. Main API + notification preference tests: 6 passed. ServerEventsModal integration still in progress.
notificationPreference: notifications.upcomingEventNotifications default true added to frontend preferences and settings, en/tr labels and server bool validation. This exposes the opt-out; durable scheduled delivery and runtime worker remain in progress.
clientUI: Event modal linked from server navigation; listing/pagination, manager create/edit/cancel and member RSVP, scoped requests and error/version-conflict recovery. Main event UI/API/preference tests: 15 passed, tsc -b passed. No visual/browser acceptance claim.
schedulerProgress: Durable delivery migration SQLite124/PG026 and atomic eligibility/dedupe notification repository implemented. Keyset event/recipient worker bounded to 100 recipients per tick; constructed in repositories/services and started/stopped in application main. Main targeted root/services/repository event/route tests passed; actual PostgreSQL delivery concurrency and full regression still required.
regressionSnapshot: Before follow-up review fixes: main actual PostgreSQL event repository/delivery tests count=3 passed (71.854s). Full client suite 263 files / 2513 tests passed (58.11s). Review then identified eligibility row-lock race, large-backlog delivery deadline, notification navigation and event-modal affordance/order/bounds gaps; these checks are not final acceptance.
eligibilityRaceAudit: New controlled PostgreSQL race test failed preference_disabled in all three main repetitions (lock wait not observed). Root cause and lock ordering are being investigated; no final PostgreSQL race acceptance. Review also found new RSVP/delivery records need explicit anonymization cleanup because tombstoning users does not fire FK deletion cascades.
workerThroughput: Start now drains up to 20 bounded pages within a shared 10-second run budget instead of waiting 15 seconds per 100-recipient page. Cursors persist across budget exhaustion. Main worker tests passed, including 305 recipients delivered in one drain. This increases bounded throughput but is not a guarantee for arbitrarily large backlogs.

Delivery locks event/preferences/membership/RSVP to align existing anonymization preference-before-membership deletion. Main PostgreSQL controlled race test passed, then all ServerEventDelivery tests count=3 passed (44.303s). Temporary PostgreSQL container stopped and auto-removed. New RSVP/delivery anonymization cleanup added.

cascadeFollowup: Explicit deepest-first delivery/RSVP/event deletion added to server cascade, including FK-disabled sibling-preserving regression. Main full Linux Docker go test ./... passed after fix (repository 48.205s), and go vet ./... passed. personalDataLifecycle: Main focused hard-delete, self-anonymization and export ownership tests passed. Administrative hard delete explicitly mirrors existing creator FK cascade under FK-disabled databases; self-anonymization retains authored shared events against the tombstoned creator while clearing private RSVP/delivery history. No actual user data deleted in testing.
